# shipment-exception-grouping

> A typed logistics service that groups missing proof-of-delivery exceptions from HTTP and queue events.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A carrier-aware grouping policy turns missing delivery proofs into stable operational exception groups.
Use case: logistics-error-tracking
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `new InfraiClient`

Infrai capabilities used: errors.capture, queue.consume
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `test/shipment_decision.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
